message.content:
The sculpture most often cited as the quintessential icon of 19th‑century art is **Auguste Rodin’s *The Thinker***.  
Rodin conceived the figure in the 1880s (the first plaster was made in 1880), and it was cast in bronze in 1902–1904. Its dramatic, contemplative pose and the way it captures the human psyche made it an instant classic—and it remains one of the most recognizable sculptures in the world today.
